rows.name: 东岳大帝
rows.display_title: 东岳泰山天齐仁圣大帝

b.name: 夜游神
b.title: 夜游神
b.description: Patrols the living world by night and seizes wandering souls (docs/01 第五层; docs/02 §六) - the arrest side of the underworld, with 黑白无常
b.description_en: Patrols the living world by night and seizes wandering souls (docs/01 fifth layer; docs/02 §6) - the arrest side of the underworld, with The Impermanences

b.name: 孟婆
b.title: 孟婆
b.description: The Meng Po - keeps the 醧忘台 at the tenth court, 「居第十殿，冥王殿前六桥之外」, and serves the broth of forgetting to souls already sentenced and bound for the next life
b.description_en: Meng Po - keeps the Terrace of Forgetting at the tenth court, beyond the six bridges before the king's hall, and serves the broth of forgetting to souls already sentenced and bound for the next life

b.name: 日游神
b.title: 日游神
b.description: Patrols the living world by day and records good and evil (docs/01 第五层; docs/02 §六). CONDUIT with 黑白无常 as the least-wrong role: ActorRole has no term for patrol-and-record
b.description_en: Patrols the living world by day and records good and evil (docs/01 fifth layer; docs/02 §6). CONDUIT with The Impermanences as the least-wrong role: ActorRole has no term for patrol-and-record

b.name: 白无常
b.title: 白无常
b.description: White Impermanence (七爷 谢必安) - captures wandering souls, brings gentle death
b.description_en: White Impermanence (Seventh Master, Xie Bi'an) - captures wandering souls, brings gentle death

b.name: 黑无常
b.title: 黑无常
b.description: Black Impermanence (八爷 范无救) - captures wicked souls with chains of darkness
b.description_en: Black Impermanence (Eighth Master, Fan Wujiu) - captures wicked souls with chains of darkness

b.name: 钟馗
b.title: 钟馗
b.description: Demon queller - hunts malignant ghosts and wards the household (沈括 《梦溪笔谈·补笔谈》卷三; Dunhuang 《除夕钟馗驱傩文》). NOT A 《玉历宝钞》 FIGURE: he appears nowhere in that text and holds no office in the ten courts. His pairing with the 罚恶司 of the 四大判官 is a late popular attribution, and this row is filed at the fifth court for want of a posting, not on a source
b.description_en: Demon queller - hunts malignant ghosts and wards the household (Shen Kuo, Dream Pool Essays, Supplement, juan 3; the Dunhuang New Year's Eve exorcism text on Zhong Kui). NOT A JADE RECORDS FIGURE: he appears nowhere in that text and holds no office in the ten courts. His pairing with the Bureau of Punishing Evil of the Four Great Judges is a late popular attribution, and this row is filed at the fifth court for want of a posting, not on a source

b.name: 枷锁将军
b.title: 枷锁将军
b.description: Puts the cangue and chains on the dead so they cannot escape; has charge of the gravest offenders (docs/01 第五层; docs/02 §六). Custody rather than punishment, so GUARDIAN with 牛头马面
b.description_en: Puts the cangue and chains on the dead so they cannot escape; has charge of the gravest offenders (docs/01 fifth layer; docs/02 §6). Custody rather than punishment, so GUARDIAN with Ox Head and Horse Face

b.name: 牛头
b.title: 牛头
b.description: Ox Head - one of the two guardians who escort the dead. 《玉历》 names the pair at the fifth court, 「牛头、马面，押赴高台」, marching the condemned up the 望乡台; the escort itself runs across all ten courts
b.description_en: Ox Head - one of the two guardians who escort the dead. The Jade Records names the pair at the fifth court, marching the condemned up the Terrace for Viewing Home; the escort itself runs across all ten courts

b.name: 神荼
b.title: 东方鬼帝
b.description: Ghost Emperor of the East - holds 鬼门关 on 桃止山 and drives out malignant ghosts; with 郁垒 one of the two ancient door gods who bind ghosts with reed rope (docs/02 §二, which gives 《山海经》 as the earliest record). 鬼门关 is not modelled; filed at the holding pen, the nearest place before the first court
b.description_en: Ghost Emperor of the East - holds the Ghost Gate on Mount Taozhi and drives out malignant ghosts; with Yulei one of the two ancient door gods who bind ghosts with reed rope (docs/02 §2, which gives the Classic of Mountains and Seas as the earliest record). The Ghost Gate is not modelled; filed at the holding pen, the nearest place before the first court

b.name: 谛听
b.title: 谛听
b.description: 地藏王菩萨's mount - discerns true from false in a soul's testimony and helps deliver the dead; white, between dog and lion in form (docs/02 §一). A subordinate, not a deity in its own right, and a figure of Chinese folk tradition and 《西游记》, not of Buddhist scripture - the docs say so. Filed with 地藏 at the intake court. GUARDIAN is the least-wrong role: it decides nothing
b.description_en: Ksitigarbha's mount - discerns true from false in a soul's testimony and helps deliver the dead; white, between dog and lion in form (docs/02 §1). A subordinate, not a deity in its own right, and a figure of Chinese folk tradition and Journey to the West, not of Buddhist scripture - the docs say so. Filed with Ksitigarbha at the intake court. GUARDIAN is the least-wrong role: it decides nothing

b.name: 郁垒
b.title: 东方鬼帝
b.description: Ghost Emperor of the East - keeps 鬼门关 together with 神荼; the east is the one quarter with two emperors (docs/01 第二层; docs/02 §二). Placement as for 神荼
b.description_en: Ghost Emperor of the East - keeps the Ghost Gate together with Shentu; the east is the one quarter with two emperors (docs/01 second layer; docs/02 §2). Placement as for Shentu

b.name: 马面
b.title: 马面
b.description: Horse Face - companion guardian of the underworld dead; see 牛头 for the fifth-court 望乡台 escort 《玉历》 names them in
b.description_en: Horse Face - companion guardian of the underworld dead; see Ox Head for the fifth-court escort to the Terrace for Viewing Home that the Jade Records names them in

b.name: 五官王
b.title: 第四殿五官王
b.description: Fourth court judge - presides over 合大地狱: withholding grain tax and rent, fraud in trade
b.description_en: Fourth court judge - presides over the Great Crushing Hell: withholding grain tax and rent, fraud in trade

b.name: 判官
b.title: 判官
b.description: Judges who compile and verify the Book of Life and Death

b.name: 卞城王
b.title: 第六殿卞城王
b.description: Sixth court judge - presides over 大叫唤大地狱: sacrilege against images and scriptures, irreverence toward heaven and earth
b.description_en: Sixth court judge - presides over the Great Howling Hell: sacrilege against images and scriptures, irreverence toward heaven and earth

b.name: 宋帝王
b.title: 第三殿宋帝王
b.description: Third court judge - presides over 黑绳大地狱: defying one's elders, inciting litigation, betraying a trust
b.description_en: Third court judge - presides over the Great Black Rope Hell: defying one's elders, inciting litigation, betraying a trust

b.name: 崔府君
b.title: 崔判官
b.description: 崔珏 - senior registrar and judge of the underworld courts; keeps the Ledger of Life and Death and assists the Ten Kings
b.description_en: Cui Jue - senior registrar and judge of the underworld courts; keeps the Ledger of Life and Death and assists the Ten Kings

b.name: 平等王
b.title: 第九殿平等王
b.description: Ninth court judge - presides over 阿鼻大地狱, the deepest hell: murder, arson, poisoning, the gravest crimes
b.description_en: Ninth court judge - presides over Avici Hell, the deepest hell: murder, arson, poisoning, the gravest crimes

b.name: 楚江王
b.title: 第二殿楚江王
b.description: Second court judge - presides over 活大地狱, the mildest punishment court: abduction, appropriating what belongs to others, maiming
b.description_en: Second court judge - presides over the Great Reviving Hell, the mildest punishment court: abduction, appropriating what belongs to others, maiming

b.name: 泰山王
b.title: 第七殿泰山王
b.description: Seventh court judge - presides over 热恼大地狱: taking bones for medicine, and the scattering of kin from one another
b.description_en: Seventh court judge - presides over the Burning Hell: taking bones for medicine, and the scattering of kin from one another

b.name: 秦广王
b.title: 第一殿秦广王
b.description: First court judge - evaluates the Ledger of Life and Death

b.name: 转轮王
b.title: 第十殿转轮王
b.description: Tenth court - the wheel of rebirth; assigns fate for the next life

b.name: 都市王
b.title: 第八殿都市王
b.description: Eighth court judge - presides over 大热恼大地狱: unfilial conduct, the parent left unkept in life and unburied in death. 「都市」 is the capital, not a marketplace
b.description_en: Eighth court judge - presides over the Great Burning Hell: unfilial conduct, the parent left unkept in life and unburied in death. Dushi here is the capital, not a marketplace

b.name: 酆都大帝
b.title: 北阴酆都大帝
b.description: 北阴大帝 - head of the whole underworld from 罗酆山 (酆都城), superior of the ten kings in the Daoist pantheon; hears the last instance of an appeal
b.description_en: Great Emperor of the Northern Yin - head of the whole underworld from Mount Luofeng (the city of Fengdu), superior of the ten kings in the Daoist pantheon; hears the last instance of an appeal

b.name: 阎罗王
b.title: 第五殿阎罗王
b.description: Fifth court judge - the best-known of the ten kings. He sat at the first court and was demoted here for leniency, by his own account: 「吾本前居第一殿，因憐屈死，屢放還陽伸雪；降調司掌…叫喚大地獄、並十六誅心小地獄」. His court tries the intent behind the act, and the 望乡台 stands in it
b.description_en: Fifth court judge - the best-known of the ten kings. He sat at the first court and was demoted here for leniency, by his own account: out of pity for the wrongly dead he kept sending them back to life to clear their names, and was reassigned to the Howling Hell and its sixteen small hells of the heart. His court tries the intent behind the act, and the Terrace for Viewing Home stands in it

b.name: 陆判
b.title: 陆判官
b.description: Underworld judge of 《聊斋志异·陆判》, where the text calls him only 陆判 or 陆公 (the name 陆之道 is a later folk addition). This project's docs give him the 阴律司, revising the underworld's laws - an office with no source, absent from the 城隍 twenty-four bureaus (docs/02 §四)
b.description_en: Underworld judge of "Judge Lu" in Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio, where the text calls him only Judge Lu or Lord Lu (the name Lu Zhidao is a later folk addition). Popular lists of the Four Great Judges give him the Bureau of Underworld Law, revising the underworld's laws - an office with no source, absent from the City God's twenty-four bureaus (docs/02 §4)

b.name: 魏征
b.title: 察查司正堂
b.description: Head of the 察查司 - audits wrongful convictions and overturns a king's misjudgment; the opening node of the Chinese appeal workflow. 察查司 is this system's term, not a classical office: 魏征 appears in the underworld narrative of 《西游记》 ch. 10 as a living chancellor writing to 崔珏, not as a seated judge, and the popular four-registrar lists that do place him usually give him the 赏善司 instead
b.description_en: Head of the Bureau of Inquiry - audits wrongful convictions and overturns a king's misjudgment; the opening node of the Chinese appeal workflow. Bureau of Inquiry is this system's term, not a classical office: Wei Zheng appears in the underworld narrative of Journey to the West ch. 10 as a living chancellor writing to Cui Jue, not as a seated judge, and the popular four-registrar lists that do place him usually give him the Bureau of Rewarding Good instead

b.name: 东岳大帝
b.title: 东岳泰山天齐仁圣大帝
b.title_zh: 东岳泰山天齐仁圣大帝
b.description: 泰山神 - holds authority over the birth of all things and protects the souls going round the wheel of rebirth; very high in popular cult (docs/01 第一层; docs/02 §一.3). NOT 泰山王: the seventh court's king is a different seat, and that row's own note records that 《玉历》 does not give the seventh court Mount Tai. REALM IS A COMPROMISE: Mount Tai is not a modelled realm
b.description_en: God of Mount Tai - holds authority over the birth of all things and protects the souls going round the wheel of rebirth; very high in popular cult (docs/01 first layer; docs/02 §1.3). NOT King Taishan: the seventh court's king is a different seat, and that row's own note records that the Jade Records does not give the seventh court Mount Tai. REALM IS A COMPROMISE: Mount Tai is not a modelled realm

b.name: 后土
b.title: 后土皇地祇
b.description: 后土皇地祇 - source of both the living and the dead, keeper of birth, death and rebirth, of the earth and the underworld; one of the Daoist 四御, called 「大地之母」 and held to be the underworld's founder (docs/01 第一层; docs/02 §一.1). Above 酆都大帝 and 东岳大帝 in the docs' ordering. REALM IS A COMPROMISE: she has no seat this system models, so she is filed at the intake court beside 地藏王菩萨 and 酆都大帝
b.description_en: Sovereign Earth Goddess - source of both the living and the dead, keeper of birth, death and rebirth, of the earth and the underworld; one of the Four Sovereigns of Daoism, called Mother Earth and held to be the underworld's founder (docs/01 first layer; docs/02 §1.1). Above the Emperor of Fengdu and the Emperor of the Eastern Peak in the docs' ordering. REALM IS A COMPROMISE: she has no seat this system models, so she is filed at the intake court beside Ksitigarbha and the Emperor of Fengdu

b.name: 周乞
b.title: 中央鬼帝
b.description: Ghost Emperor of the Centre - on 抱犊山, coordinates the other four quarters and keeps the balance of yin and yang (docs/02 §二). 《元始上真众仙记》 seats two emperors here, 周乞 and 嵇康; this row carries the first name. 抱犊山 is not modelled; filed at the holding pen
b.description_en: Ghost Emperor of the Centre - on Mount Baodu, coordinates the other four quarters and keeps the balance of yin and yang (docs/02 §2). The Yuanshi Shangzhen Zhongxian Ji seats two emperors here, Zhou Qi and Ji Kang; this row carries the first name. Mount Baodu is not modelled; filed at the holding pen

b.name: 地藏王菩萨
b.title: 地藏王菩萨
b.description: Bodhisattva of the Great Vow - 地狱不空，誓不成佛. Delivers souls out of the hells; relief path for wrongful deaths and those in the torture chambers
b.description_en: Bodhisattva of the Great Vow, who will not become a Buddha until the hells are empty. Delivers souls out of the hells; relief path for wrongful deaths and those in the torture chambers

b.name: 张衡
b.title: 北方鬼帝
b.description: Ghost Emperor of the North - sits at 罗酆山 in 酆都 and keeps the underworld's punishments (docs/02 §二). 《元始上真众仙记》 seats two emperors here, 张衡 and 杨云; this row carries the first name. 罗酆山 is not modelled; filed at the holding pen
b.description_en: Ghost Emperor of the North - sits at Mount Luofeng in Fengdu and keeps the underworld's punishments (docs/02 §2). The Yuanshi Shangzhen Zhongxian Ji seats two emperors here, Zhang Heng and Yang Yun; this row carries the first name. Mount Luofeng is not modelled; filed at the holding pen

b.name: 杜子仁
b.title: 南方鬼帝
b.description: Ghost Emperor of the South - governs the southern ghost domain from 罗浮山 and subdues violent souls (docs/02 §二). 罗浮山 is not modelled; filed at the holding pen
b.description_en: Ghost Emperor of the South - governs the southern ghost domain from Mount Luofu and subdues violent souls (docs/02 §2). Mount Luofu is not modelled; filed at the holding pen

b.name: 赵文和
b.title: 西方鬼帝
b.description: Ghost Emperor of the West - governs the western ghost domain from 嶓冢山 (docs/02 §二). 《元始上真众仙记》 seats two emperors here, 赵文和 and 王真人; this row carries the first name. 嶓冢山 is not modelled; filed at the holding pen
b.description_en: Ghost Emperor of the West - governs the western ghost domain from Mount Bozhong (docs/02 §2). The Yuanshi Shangzhen Zhongxian Ji seats two emperors here, Zhao Wenhe and Wang Zhenren; this row carries the first name. Mount Bozhong is not modelled; filed at the holding pen

b.description: No longer used (2026-10-29): an acquitted soul of Diyu goes straight to rebirth. Formerly: pure merit souls - highest bliss, for as long as the merit lasts; when it is spent the soul returns to the wheel
Souls awaiting reunion with loved ones. SOURCE UNKNOWN: no underworld place by this name appears in 《玉历宝钞》 or 《十王经》; treat as this project's own element until a source is produced
Intake court - the Ledger of Life and Death is read and the soul's case opened at the 孽镜台 (Mirror of Retribution); no punishment is administered here
活大地狱 - the mildest punishment court; abducting the young, seizing others' property, maiming others' eyes, ears, hands or feet
黑绳大地狱 - 忤逆尊长, 教唆兴讼, 背恩失节: defying one's elders, inciting litigation, betraying a trust
合大地狱 - refusing grain tax and rent, fraud in trade
叫唤大地狱 and the 十六诛心小地狱 - the court that tries the intent behind the act: malice, ingratitude, envy, miserliness. The 望乡台 stands here
大叫唤大地狱 - sacrilege and irreverence
热恼大地狱 - taking bones for medicine, scattering of kin
大热恼大地狱 - unfilial conduct: the parent left unkept in life and unburied in death
阿鼻大地狱 - the deepest hell; murder, arson, the crimes with no remedy
The wheel of rebirth - sentences are complete; the next life is assigned and the broth of forgetting drunk. No punishment is administered here
Souls awaiting judgment - held before the first court reads the ledger
